cards.answer: Veigar is a mage who permanently gains ability power through champion hits and takedowns. His cage stuns enemies at its edges, setting up magic damage and an ultimate that hits harder as its target loses health.
cards.counterplay: Avoid the cage edges and retreat before your health gets low.
